title: NEB Class 11 Mock Exam 01 — Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics

questions.prompt: Enzymes, the biological catalysts that speed up reactions in cells, are chemically which class of biomolecules?
questions.explanation: Enzymes are globular proteins; only a few RNA molecules (ribozymes) act catalytically outside this rule.

questions.prompt: Which organelle is called the powerhouse of the eukaryotic cell because it carries out aerobic respiration?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria generate ATP through oxidative phosphorylation.

questions.prompt: The system of binomial nomenclature used to name every species scientifically was introduced by:
questions.explanation: Linnaeus introduced binomial nomenclature; Whittaker proposed the five-kingdom system and Woese the three domains.

questions.prompt: A lichen is a dual organism produced by symbiosis between:
questions.explanation: The algal partner photosynthesises while the fungal partner absorbs water and minerals and gives shelter.

questions.prompt: Spirogyra, recognised by its ribbon-shaped spiral chloroplasts, belongs to:
questions.explanation: Spirogyra is a filamentous member of Chlorophyceae, the green algae.

questions.prompt: How many moles are present in 44 g of carbon dioxide (molar mass 44 g/mol)?
What volume does 0.5 mol of an ideal gas occupy at STP?
questions.explanation: At STP one mole occupies 22.4 L, so 0.5 mol occupies 11.2 L.

questions.prompt: According to Bohr's model, the ratio of the radius of the n = 2 orbit to that of the n = 1 orbit of hydrogen is:
questions.explanation: Radius is proportional to n², so r₂/r₁ = 4/1.

questions.prompt: For a d subshell, the azimuthal quantum number l has the value:
questions.explanation: l = 0, 1, 2, 3 correspond to s, p, d, f respectively.

questions.prompt: The maximum number of electrons that the M shell (n = 3) can accommodate is:
questions.explanation: Capacity = 2n² = 2 × 9 = 18 electrons for n = 3.

questions.prompt: The discriminant of the quadratic equation 2x² − 5x + 3 = 0 is:
questions.explanation: D = b² − 4ac = 25 − 24 = 1, so roots are real, distinct and rational.

questions.prompt: If α and β are the roots of x² − 7x + 10 = 0, then α + β equals:
questions.explanation: Sum of roots = −b/a = 7 for this equation.

questions.prompt: For every x in [−1, 1], sin⁻¹x + cos⁻¹x equals:
questions.explanation: Inverse sine and cosine are complementary on [−1, 1]: their sum is π/2.

questions.prompt: The general solution of the equation sin θ = 0 is:
questions.explanation: Sine vanishes at every integer multiple of π, n ∈ ℤ.

questions.prompt: The sum of the infinite geometric series 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/8 + … is:
Two forces of 3 N and 4 N act at right angles to each other. The magnitude of their resultant is:
questions.explanation: R = √(3² + 4²) = 5 N when θ = 90° so the cross term vanishes.

questions.prompt: Which of the following products of two vectors yields a scalar quantity?
questions.explanation: The dot product AB cos θ is scalar; cross products, sums and differences of vectors are vector quantities.

questions.prompt: The escape velocity from the surface of the Earth is approximately:
questions.explanation: v_e = √(2gR) ≈ 11.2 km/s for Earth; 7.9 km/s is the near-surface orbital velocity.

questions.prompt: How much heat is required to raise the temperature of 2 kg of water by 10 °C? (c = 4200 J kg⁻¹ °C⁻¹)
During the melting of ice at 0 °C and normal pressure, the temperature of the ice-water mixture:
questions.explanation: Latent heat of fusion is absorbed without any temperature change until all ice melts.
